```plato

    // True when one of the two triangles of edge e is face f.
    FlipTouchesFace(topology: TriangleMeshTopology, e: Integer, f: Integer): Boolean
        => (topology.EdgeCorners[e].Value / 3 == f)
            .Or(topology.CornerTwins[topology.EdgeCorners[e].Value].Value / 3 == f);
```
